arguments.command:
python -c "
import re
# Test left-aligned pattern
pattern = r'(.+?) * world'
m = re.search(pattern, 'hello       world')
print('Match:', repr(m.group(1)) if m else None)

# What about center-aligned?
import parse
p = parse.Parser('hello {:^} world')
print('Center expression:', repr(p._expression))
m2 = re.search(p._expression, 'hello  there     world', re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
print('Center match:', repr(m2.group(1)) if m2 else None)
"
